methods.label: Keep the product constant
methods.explanation: The string length $L$ and frequency $f$ satisfy $L\times f=\text{constant}$. When $L$ becomes $1/2$ of its original value, $f$ becomes 2 times its original value.
methods.levelReason: Elementary inverse proportion and the meaning of a multiplicative factor suffice.
